final_message: I parsed the log file by reading line by line and detecting entry headers with timestamp, level, service, and message. I filtered only ERROR and CRITICAL entries (case insensitive). For each entry, I converted the timestamp to UTC ISO 8601 format with "Z". I collected extra lines as traceback and extracted the last line as the exception message or null if none. I summed repeat counts from any following repeat lines. I accumulated counts by service. Finally, I wrote the results to workspace/errors.json in the required JSON structure with fields timestamp_utc, service, level (uppercase), message, exception, repeat_count, and counts_by_service. The output file is ready for Acme log-triage conventions review.
